IncidentBot: INCIDENT CREATED • smart-routing:region-roulette-detect at 1768504321
IncidentBot: Severity: P1 — routing fallback loop detected affecting EU region; elevated error rates for tool-calling requests. Auto-pager triggered.

Sam (oncall-sre): I'm on it, paging @Priya and @Mateo. taking lead.
Priya (sre): ack, joining. seeing error spikes from EU routers to secondary variants.
Mateo (runtime): what are the error messages? logs?
Sam (oncall-sre): past 12m: 502 for tool calls, stack shows: 
```
2026-03-15T08:12:05Z ERROR router-eu request_id=abc123 model=gptx-7b-q4 err=tools_not_supported
2026-03-15T08:12:05Z WARN router-eu fallback -> eu-variant-2 (gptx-7b-q4) latency=240ms
2026-03-15T08:12:06Z ERROR router-eu request_id=def456 model=gptx-7b-q4 err=context_truncated
```
Sam (oncall-sre): operator note: routing tried primary eu-fp16 then fell back repeatedly to gptx-7b-q4. q4 variant doesn't advertise tool_call capability in compatibility matrix.

Anya (ml-infra): that's bad — q4 variant is quantized and we historically disabled tool_call for Q4 builds because of ABI differences. Compatibility matrix shows tool_call: false for gptx-7b-q4 in staging but prod routing policy ignored it.
Mateo (runtime): checking routing policy blobs. running: `redis-cli -s /var/run/router.sock HGET routing:eu policy`
deploy-bot: command accepted: HGET routing:eu policy -> returned JSON
Mateo (runtime): policy snippet: 
```json
{"prefer": "latency", "fallback_order": ["eu-fp16","eu-q4","global-fp16"], "compat_check": "none", "max_failover": 3}
```
Mateo (runtime): key issue: `compat_check` is set to "none" — router allowed variant fallbacks without validating feature flags.

Priya (sre): rolling mitigation options: 1) flip compat_check to "strict" (reject variants that don't advertise required features), 2) pin eu route to eu-fp16 only, 3) temporarily disable cross-region fallback.
Sam (oncall-sre): impact assessment: Lina/CS, can you confirm customer-facing scope?
Lina (cs): pulling list — initial query shows ~12 customers had tool-assisted workflows routed through EU. Estimated error rate 28-36% over last 20m. Some report missing tool outputs (webhooks not called). Preparing status update.
Mikhail (product): any customer data loss? Are outputs corrupted or just missing tool calls?
Lina (cs): tool calls returned 4xx error payloads; actions didn't run. no persisted data lost, but user workflows blocked.

Mateo (runtime): I'm going to test compat_check flip in canary: `HSET routing:eu policy "compat_check" "strict"` on canary routers first. If works, push to prod.
Priya (sre): also prepare rollback plan in case strict breaks legitimate fallbacks.
Sam (oncall-sre): execute. Mateo, tell me when canary shows green for 5m.
Mateo (runtime): canary update in progress. logs: `deploy-bot: patch policy applied to router-eu-canary`
deploy-bot: router-eu-canary policy reload ok
Mateo (runtime): canary: 5m pass. errors for tool calls drop from 32% -> 1.5% on canary.
Sam (oncall-sre): /approve push to prod. Priya to coordinate rollout.
Priya (sre): rolling to prod now in 3 waves, 30s stagger. command: `kubectl -n inference exec router-eu-0 -- redis-cli HSET routing:eu policy compat_check strict` (abbreviated).
deploy-bot: rollout started: router-eu-{0..5} updated

(10m later)
Priya (sre): all EU routers patched. global error rate back to baseline. tool_call 200s restored.
Sam (oncall-sre): status: mitigation succeeded. next: root cause and follow-ups.
Mateo (runtime): quick RCA draft: routing policy schema had new field `compat_check` introduced last quarter but the validation pipeline allowed old policies without the field. a config migration failed to set the default to "strict". some older policy blobs defaulted to "none".
Anya (ml-infra): compounding factor: compatibility matrix entries for quantized variants are incomplete — gptx-7b-q4 lacked `tool_call: false` in prod metadata (it existed in staging). That allowed router to believe variant might work if compat_check had been strict, but since compat_check was none, the first fallout was wrong variant selection.
Mikhail (product): timeline for fix we want: 1) backfill missing compatibility flags for all quantized variants in prod metadata; 2) schema validation on policy writes to reject compat_check=none for routes that permit tool calling; 3) add automated test: route-sim that validates routing decisions for tool_call requests.
Sam (oncall-sre): agree. add to post-incident playbook: ensure default compat_check=strict for new policies.
Lina (cs): customer comms ready: we've posted a short status page note and customer's success reps pinged top affected customers. no PII exposed.
Priya (sre): I'm opening a follow-up ticket in infra-track: INF-2026-349 "routing: enforce compat_check+backfill matrix". assigning to @Anya and @Mateo.
Mateo (runtime): I also pushed a quick monitoring alert for any future routing fallback where `fallback_variant` != `primary_variant` && request.features.tool_call == true; threshold: 1% errors over 5m triggers pager.
Anya (ml-infra): I'll schedule a sweep to sync prod metadata from model-onboard repo and add a CI gate that verifies feature flags (tool_call, max_ctx_tokens) are present for every prod variant.

Sam (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'm going offline for lunch at 09:20 UTC. Priya will handle on-call until 12:00. @Priya please post final incident summary and close thread when follow-ups are tracked.
Priya (sre): acknowledged. adding timeline and impact to incident board.
Lina (cs): sending customer follow-up note template to #customer-facing-drafts.
Mikhail (product): thanks team. main action items documented.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • smart-routing:region-roulette-detect at 1768511521 — mitigation confirmed, postmortem required.

Sam (oncall-sre): closing from my side. Priya will publish the postmortem template in ~2 hours. :white_check_mark:
